critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Orders endpoint returns the pydantic model (good — no _id leak), but create_order pops _id from a dict that's not returned; harmless. Consider using response_model_exclude to avoid Mongo-side mutation.
seed_products uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — consider migrating to lifespan context.
EmailStr via pydantic ensures basic validation — OK.
Chat endpoint persists history but also uses LlmChat session_id — emergentintegrations handles history internally; duplication is fine but noted.

success_rate.frontend: ~60% verified (home, shop, filters, product detail, gallery render OK; form submissions not fully verifiable via testids)

seed_data_creation: No explicit seed; backend auto-seeds 8 products on startup. Tests created TEST_-prefixed orders/custom-orders/contact messages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (14 tests, all passing). For frontend, focus next run on verifying that the expected data-testid values are present: the visible UI (Add to cart on product page, checkout/custom-order/contact/chat widgets) exists and renders correctly, so any failure is likely a testid naming mismatch rather than a functional bug.
